sampling_verification.rule: First 40 and last 20 turns for >60 turns; no duplicate sampling for <=60 turns
sampling_verification.details: Synthetic tests confirmed exact 60-turn sampling for 100 turns (1-40 + 81-100), full retention for 6 turns and 60 turns.

classification_firewall.rule: Strict JSON classification; accept Client Coaching >= 0.80; reject others to rejected_meetings with 0 embeddings

dual_stream_extraction.rule: Framework and voice samples stored in separate streams; voice samples verbatim coach dialogue only (400-700 chars)

embedding_integrity.rule: 1024-dimensional embedding vectors for all vault chunks; 0 embeddings for rejected meetings

atomic_database_operations.rule: Single atomic call per session with advisory lock; session isolation; no lost chunks; no cross-session pollution
